defect_mechanism: Count register fails to preserve net occupancy during simultaneous active write_en and read_en (increments count by 1)

propagation_chain.event: Trigger condition satisfied (simultaneous active write_en & read_en)
Count desynchronizes from true pointer occupancy ((write_ptr - read_ptr) % 16)
Premature full/empty or pointer overflow manifests as testbench failure

invariant_violation: Occupancy conservation invariant count(t+1) == count(t) during simultaneous read/write

metadata.fix_template: if (write_en && !full && read_en && !empty) count <= count; else if (write_en && !full) count <= count + 1; else if (read_en && !empty) count <= count - 1;
